offers.title: Senior Design System Engineer
offers.description:
Design for the people in the tiny chairs

Famly makes software that lifts paperwork off early-years educators so they can spend more of the day with the children. It also lets parents follow their child's day while they are at work.

We are hiring someone to build our design system inside the design team: the components, prototyping tools and other shared pieces that keep the whole product consistent.

About Famly
We want to stop paperwork from crowding out the fun of working with young children. Our platform takes care of routine admin for educators and staff, and our podcasts and articles remind them why they chose this work in the first place.

About the role

You are at home where design and code overlap. With a small team you will own Famly's design system: the components, patterns and docs that product teams, and more and more AI agents, build with every day.

The team exists to keep things coherent. Every screen should feel like part of one product. You will give builders what they need to meet our standards, and keep talking with them so the system improves.

You know design systems in technical depth, and you care just as much about how the product feels to use.

The team sits in our Copenhagen office, but you may also be based elsewhere.

What you'll be doing

  • Build production-ready React and TypeScript components for the design system.

  • Design component APIs that are hard to use wrongly, and version them so upgrades are painless.

  • Write docs good enough that a new engineer, or an AI agent, can use a component correctly without help.

  • Keep the system reliable with tests, visual regression checks and a calm release process.

  • Learn our frontend well enough to know where a pattern is used and what a change would break.

  • Review and improve existing components for consistency, accessibility and reuse.

  • Own the code half of our design standard so that design intent reaches production intact.

  • Speak up when a design will not work in code, and propose an alternative.

  • Work with PMs, designers and engineers across teams, and bring them ideas early.
offers.requirements:
You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • You have 5+ years of frontend work in B2B SaaS, design system work included.

  • You are strong in React, TypeScript and CSS.

  • You care about craft: spacing, motion, states and the small things that make a component feel done.

  • You think in systems and prefer reusable, documented components to one-off fixes.

  • You turn a rough idea into a working prototype quickly.

  • You own your work from discovery to release.

  • You know the gap between "works" and "is right", and you say so.

The interview process looks like:

  • A short intro call with our people team

  • A logical reasoning test

  • 1st interview: a conversation with the head of product design

  • A take-home assignment

  • 2nd interview: presenting the assignment to two designers

And who are Famly?

You may be asking yourself, so what is Famly? It started when one of our founders saw how much of daycare still ran on paper, and how little a parent got to see of a child's day. Monthly notebooks passed between home and nursery were not enough, so he and a friend set out to fix it.

Today a team of around 180 builds Famly for thousands of settings and a great many parents. 

We take care of the admin so educators can focus on children, and we bring home and nursery closer together. Whether you build, sell or support, you will work on everything from staff rotas and invoices to child development and messages to parents.

How we work

A few principles guide us: keep it simple, be friendly, set the pace, and work among talented people.

We do not think people should have to choose between an ambitious workplace and a pleasant one. You can be ambitious and kind, and we hope you will see that when you meet us. 

We ask that you help others do well, try to be a bit better each day, and get things done. Above all, look at your work from the 'tiny chair': through the eyes of the people working in childcare every day.

What’s in it for you?

  • A good pension, private health insurance and paid parental leave.

  • A clear career path with coaching, a $1000 learning budget and any book you want, paid for. 

  • Time, space, leadership and budget set aside for your growth.

  • The tools and technology you need to do your best work.

  • Smart colleagues who are also generous with their help.

  • Plenty of ownership and freedom to take on new challenges.

  • Great equipment, noise-cancelling headphones included.

  • Four office days a week by default, with flexibility when life needs it.

We want to fill the role soon, so apply today and send us:

  • Your CV

  • A short cover letter on what you would bring

  • A portfolio, attached or linked

We look forward to hearing from you!

The inside scoop on Famly

Want to know more? Our website tells you about:

  • our product and our mission

  • What it's like working at Famly

Famly wants a team that reflects many backgrounds, views and life experiences. We do not discriminate on any grounds, and we welcome applications from everyone.

offers.title: Customer Success Manager UK
offers.description:
Do you enjoy building relationships and solving problems for small businesses? Do you like turning satisfied customers into loyal ones? Famly wants a proactive, numbers-minded Customer Success Manager to look after and grow our Small-to-Medium Business (SMB) customers in the UK and the Nordics.

What you’ll be doing 🛠️

As their go-to advisor, you make sure our SMB customers, from single settings to small groups, get the most out of Famly.

  • Own the Relationship: Be the main contact for your accounts and build trust with the people who make decisions.

  • Drive Retention & Growth: Spot churn risk early from usage data, hold regular check-ins and run account reviews so customers reach their goals.

  • Be a Product Expert: Teach customers what Famly can do and suggest solutions based on their feedback.

  • Expand our Footprint: Find upsell and cross-sell openings and work with Sales to grow Net New ARR.

  • Act as an Internal Advocate: Bring customer feedback to the rest of the company and follow it up.

  • Collaborate Seamlessly: Work with Onboarding, Sales, Advisory and Product so customers have a smooth first year and beyond.
offers.requirements:
What excites you 🌟

A job where your work shows up directly in the numbers and in how customers fare over time:

Impact on the Bottom Line: You will add to our ARR growth, retention and upsell targets.

Data as Your Guide: You keep account records accurate in our CRM and use the data to decide where your time matters most.

AI as Your Teammate: You use AI tools like Claude every day and join our weekly sessions where we try new things together.

Challenge & Growth: You do well when things move fast, and your positive attitude gives customers and colleagues confidence.

Genuine Empathy: You care about your customers' problems and look ahead to solve them.

What excites us 🔥

Someone ready to build lasting partnerships 🤝

  • Exceptional Communicator: You communicate clearly and warmly with everyone you work with.

  • Collaborative Team Player: You help your teammates and are used to working across departments.

  • Data and CRM Savvy: You use CRM and analysis tools to judge account health and find growth.

  • Results-Driven Focus: You set goals and reach them, for customers and for us.

  • Proactive Prioritiser: You manage many accounts at once, keeping churn low while growing revenue

👯 You’ll be working with

A lively team of CSMs and Onboarding Specialists who care about their customers and back each other up on hard days. We come from many countries and share a love of the work. Expect energy, support and a lot of GIFs.

💚 About Famly

Famly wants every child to get a good start in life, by supporting the early-years professionals who make that happen.

It began when one of our founders saw how much of daycare still ran on pen and paper, and how far that kept parents from their child's day. Together with a friend he set out to change it.

Today Famly is used by many thousands of childcare professionals and parents to:

  • Talk in real time

  • Cut admin

  • Plan better, in pedagogy and in finances

  • And give more time to the children

Want to help? We would love to have you.

🚀 Why you’ll love working at Famly

  • Smart, kind colleagues who help each other

  • Real ownership and the freedom to try new things

  • Great equipment, noise-cancelling headphones included

  • Learning from peers, leaders and coaches, plus team and company events

  • Personal and professional growth

  • A mission you can see working every day

In the Copenhagen HQ, we also have:

  • A daily lunch buffet, a full drinks fridge and lots of snacks

  • Board game nights, climbing, Friday bars, quarterly parties, team dinners and more!

📋 The interview process

What to expect:

  1. An intro call with our People & Talent team

  2. A reasoning test

  3. An interview with the head of customer success

  4. A case presentation to the hiring team

  5. A final interview with the country manager

  6. Reference check

We move quickly and keep it personal.

📬 Ready to apply?

We are hiring now, so do not wait.

👉 Send us:

  • Your CV, and

  • A note or short video on why Famly and why you 🎥

Famly wants a team that reflects many backgrounds, views and life experiences. We do not discriminate on any grounds, and we welcome applications from everyone.
